candidate.mark_source: CoinMarketCap RAY/USD live converter observed during this run

regime_evidence.note: The $2.3B Raydium figure is reported tokenized-stock DEX secondary trading in Q3 through Sep. 18, not tokenized-equity issuance/AUM. The cumulative xStocks figure is transaction volume, not capital stock.

incentive_filter.official_evidence: xStocks officially launched xPoints as an incentive program explicitly designed to reward trading, liquidity provision and DeFi integration. This means xStocks-related activity cannot be treated as clean discretionary capital migration without separating non-incentivized users/volume from points-motivated activity.
incentive_filter.important_nuance: DefiLlama reports zero protocol-level Raydium incentives over 24h/7d/30d, but that does not remove the external xStocks incentive layer. Raydium's own fees and RAY buybacks are economically real outputs even when some underlying order flow may be externally subsidized.

protocol_economics.ray_value_capture: Official Raydium fee rules route a share of swap fees to open-market RAY buybacks; this direct protocol-funded demand remains valid. Bought-back RAY is held by the protocol rather than necessarily burned, so governance/disposition risk remains.

leadership.evidence: The Sep. 14 one-day Solana tokenized-equity leadership signal has now gained multi-quarter persistence evidence: Raydium Q3 tokenized-stock DEX volume is about $2.3B and up ~40% QoQ through Sep. 18, while RAY itself is again showing positive price/turnover confirmation. However, the newly verified xPoints incentive layer means the quality of that flow is lower than previously assumed.

wallet_quality.note: No newly funded, historically selective, demonstrably independent RAY accumulator cohort was verified in this scan. Generic whale labels are not counted.

structural_gate.contract: Established Solana token; prior research verified mint and freeze authorities revoked.
structural_gate.liquidity_executability: PASS; RAY has broad CEX/DEX coverage and current turnover is ample for a ~2.5% paper-NAV starter.
remaining_caveats: large protocol/treasury holdings and governance/disposition risk for accumulated buyback tokens
RAY is strongly extended over 30 days, increasing chase/mean-reversion risk
xStocks points contaminate the tokenized-stock flow-quality signal

paper_portfolio_decision.reason: Actual tokenized-stock secondary usage and RAY value capture are real and persistent, but xPoints explicitly rewards the same trading/liquidity behaviors used as regime evidence. With RAY already sharply repriced and no fresh selective-wallet convergence, confirmation discipline requires a clean post-incentive or incentive-adjusted usage signal before a starter.
